code: export const getToken=()=>localStorage.getItem("token");export const getRole=()=>localStorage.getItem("role");export const getUserId=()=>localStorage.getItem("userId");export const getAccountId=()=>localStorage.getItem("accountId");export const isAuthenticated=()=>{const token=getToken();return token!==null;};export const logout=()=>{localStorage.clear();window.location.href="/";};/* Idle-timeout auto-logout - no backend/paid service required. */export const startIdleTimer=function(){let timeoutMinutes=arguments.length>0&&arguments[0]!==undefined?arguments[0]:15;let idleTimer;const resetIdleTimer=()=>{clearTimeout(idleTimer);idleTimer=setTimeout(()=>{if(isAuthenticated()){logout();}},timeoutMinutes*60*1000);};["click","keydown","mousemove","scroll","touchstart"].forEach(eventName=>window.addEventListener(eventName,resetIdleTimer));resetIdleTimer();};
